reviews.conclusion: An overworld eye measurement is followed by game/settings menus at proxy 2.25-4.25 and 7-9.25 s. Between them the capture becomes vertically compressed/obscured at 4.5-6.75 s. Visible menus span 4.25-5.25 s in total, short of the 5.917 s deficit; the obscured pause state is unknown. Exact closure is unresolved.
Nether exit into the ocean is followed by a pause/options/video-settings visit totaling 2.0-2.5 s, compatible with -2.1833 s. Subsequent inventory activity is not counted as paused.
Bastion trading contains two pause/options sequences. Combined menu exposure is approximately 1.75-2.75 s, compatible with the -2.1 s deficit. Inventory handling remains distinct from pause time.

Nether traversal has settings/video menus at proxy 4.75-5.75 and 11.75-12 s. Their combined 1.25-2.25 s sampled bounds contain the 1.8 s deficit. Remaining retained frames show normal movement/debug/inventory use.
End entry is followed by pause/options/video-settings for 1.5-2.0 s, compatible with -1.7667 s. The player then continues in the End; no attempt reset is visible.

After the completed dragon fight the view turns black at proxy 2.25-4 s, then returns to the overworld. This is an ordinary post-completion exit transition. Its full visible black duration bounds are 1.75-2.25 s, which do not exactly match the 1.583 s deficit; GUI update timing within loading is unmeasured, so exact closure stays unresolved.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
